description:
THE NEW JOUTA LINE IS NOW READY TO SHIP!

After a 2 year hiatus the now Jouta Blue Line Trikes and Quads are finally back in stock! It was worth the wait. The new Jouta Blue line is still modular but there have been tremendous improvements made. They are all Aluminum now instead of Tensile Steel and are almost much lighter in weight, Also they are indirect steer no instead of direct steer.

The Jouta Quads are 2WD. It is available with either 20 x 1.50″ Tires, or 20 x 4″ Fat Tires

Shipping is $125.00 and is added to the total price in the cart. The Jouta Quad is 75% assembled (in 1 Box). Please call for shipping quotes to AK, HI, Canada or any foreign address.
